prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.7%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.3%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Cloud Sync Reassurance Copy', 'Desktop rendering progress & tips on wait screen']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['De-prioritize sign-in to after adoption selection', 'Grid pet selection screen with live preview', 'Two-column path selection layout', 'Desktop notification prompt on onboarding finish', 'Interactive Pet Personality Quiz Redesign', 'Desktop Visibility Helper Banner', 'Desktop Path Comparison Hints']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Interactive Tutorial
candidates.change: Adds a new interactive tutorial screen after home_intro demonstrating how to drag, hide, summon, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support emails highlight user confusion around controlling or talking to the pet post-onboarding, leading to drop-off at the final step.

home_intro.hint: Click Next to view a 10-second guide on desktop controls.

new_pet_controls_tutorial.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_pet_controls_tutorial.body: Drag your pet anywhere, right-click to hide or summon, and click to start chatting!

components.text: Right-click your pet for controls & settings

candidates.title: Existing Account Sync Warning Note
candidates.change: Adds explicit reassurance copy on the sign-in screen clarifying how signing in preserves existing desktop pets and prevents reset issues.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pets Safe
sign_in.body: Sign in with your existing account to instantly sync and preserve all your desktop companions.
sign_in.hint: Using the same email restores your existing pets without resetting progress.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Customization Stage
candidates.change: Redesigns adoption_certificate into a stage layout with editable pet name field, official stamp badge, and live preview of the pet.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 60.9% with a median time of 89s, showing friction before finalization.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a name to finalize the adoption certificate!

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Spawn Readiness Tracker
candidates.change: Enhances the waiting screen with a status checklist component and live estimation timer for pet initialization.
candidates.why: Home step waiting screen has a high mean time of 2336s and 3 support tickets mentioned pets failing to show on desktop.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop
waiting.body: We are generating animations and configuring desktop interactions.

candidates.title: Story & Path Stage Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns choose_path screen with a spotlight layout featuring path choice cards highlighting quick pick versus custom pet creation.
candidates.why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating indecision on path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-go companion or create a custom pet from your photos.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Preparation Guide Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new photo preparation guidance screen before photo upload explaining clear photo requirements to avoid AI rendering errors.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails regarding failed or distorted custom pet generation during photo upload.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure photos have good lighting and single subjects.

new_photo_guide.headline: Photo Preparation Tips
new_photo_guide.body: For the best custom pet results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward.

components.text: Clear lighting, no blur, one pet visible

candidates.title: Quick Desktop Control Hints on Home Intro
candidates.change: Adds mouse control tip cards and keyboard shortcut hints directly to the home_intro welcome screen.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and users frequently contact support regarding post-onboarding pet control confusion.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop. Here is how to interact with it.
home_intro.hint: Left-click to talk, click and drag to move, right-click for options.

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Cloud Backup Incentive Badge
candidates.change: Displays a prominent cloud backup badge and incentive offer explaining that signing in protects pets across devices.
candidates.why: Sign-in step converts at 77.0% and 8 support tickets were sent about missing/reset pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Companion
sign_in.body: Create or sign into your account to unlock cross-device cloud saving and protect your pet.

components.text: Never lose your custom pets or progress

candidates.title: Pet Selection Screen Card Grid Layout
candidates.change: Updates the pick_friend screen layout to carousel with interactive pet sound preview buttons and rounded choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption is the lowest converting step in the entire funnel at 60.9%.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Friend
pick_friend.body: Select a companion to bring to life on your desktop.

candidates.title: Animated Story Prologue Screen Flow
candidates.change: Adds an animated story intro screen new_story_prologue at the start of onboarding to establish context before path selection.
candidates.why: The choose_path median time is 8s but mean time is 514s, indicating user confusion or hesitation at startup.

new_story_prologue.headline: Bring Your Desktop to Life
new_story_prologue.body: Discover virtual companions that live right on your screen.
